sn7.10:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
sn7.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa catuddasa balivaddā naṭṭhā honti.
sn7.10:1.3: atha kho bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo te balivadde gavesanto yena so vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā addasa bhagavantaṃ tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
sn7.10:1.4: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
sn7.10:16.1: evaṃ vutte bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.10:16.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama.
sn7.10:16.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhinti, evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn7.10:16.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn7.10:16.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn7.10:17.1: alattha kho bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
sn7.10:17.2: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn7.10:17.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn7.10:17.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.
